decisions.title: Transient departure delivery

decisions.disposition: Atomic committed effect envelope: fresh live epoch on process/replacement/reopen, publication sequence and ordinal; train/platform/bell IDs, current source location. decisions.acceptance: Rejected tick/retry silent, duplicate delivery once, multiple callbacks same tick distinct ordinals, replacement/reconnect no replay, both peers/local gesture controls.
